description: This file defines a Clock class for managing and manipulating virtual time within a browser context, including functions for fast forwarding, installing, pausing, resuming, and setting fixed or system time, with parsing utilities for time strings.

classes.name: Clock
classes.description: A class to control and manipulate the clock within a browser context for testing purposes.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Stops the clock and disposes of all init scripts.

methods.name: fastForward
methods.description: Fast forwards the clock by a specified number of ticks or seconds.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a specific time or the current system time into the clock.

methods.name: pauseAt
methods.description: Pauses the clock at a specific time.

methods.name: resumeNoReply
methods.description: Resumes the clock without waiting for a response.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the clock, optionally with progress tracking.

methods.name: setFixedTime
methods.description: Sets the clock to a fixed specific time.

methods.name: setSystemTime
methods.description: Sets the system time for the clock.

methods.name: runFor
methods.description: Runs the clock forward for a specified duration.
